ai.title: AI-Driven Development Adoption
ai.description: Led the adoption of AI-assisted development practices across the engineering team to accelerate delivery and improve code quality.
details: Developed a CAS parser proof of concept in under 2 hours using AI tooling, then delegated refinement to a team member who delivered the production-ready parser in 2 days — a task that would typically take a month.
Enforced strict static code analysis thresholds in SonarQube, mandating a minimum of 80% line coverage — made practical by AI-assisted test generation.
Introduced steering documents into projects to guide AI tooling on coding standards, reducing self-review cycles and manual corrections.

wealth-mgmt.title: Wealth Management Platform
wealth-mgmt.description: Designed and built an in-house wealth management platform, replacing an outsourced solution while incorporating additional features requested by stakeholders.
details: Executed data migration of over 2 lakh client records from the outsourced vendor with zero downtime.
Ensured a seamless transition experience for both end clients and internal administrators.
Set up performance monitoring and alerting dashboards for proactive issue detection.
